task_spec.text: Reply to the crash report about the login rate-limit issue in the channel where Hubert Marek is a member and has reacted 👍 to a teammate's post, letting them know it's already been patched.

access_plan: Use conversations.list to enumerate channels and conversations.members to find channels where Hubert Marek (users.info/users.list) holds membership; for each such channel's message pool (via conversations.history across the workspace, since the qualifying reaction may sit in any channel) use reactions.get to locate his thumbsup reaction. Among the qualifying channel(s), scan conversations.history for the message whose text is the login rate-limit crash report, then call chat.postMessage with that message's channel and thread_ts set to its ts.
